name: Fall Clay Classic
format: Round-robin pools into a single-elimination draw. Best of three sets, 10-point match tiebreak in place of a third set.
entryFeeNote: Per player, per event. Play a second event for $15.
description: Our biggest weekend of the year. Two days of clay-court tennis for every level, lunch on the clubhouse porch, and trophies for winners and finalists.

name: Holiday Mixed Doubles Social
format: One-day round robin. Short sets, rotating partners, prizes for the top pair.
description: A low-pressure Saturday of mixed doubles to close out the year. Sign up solo and we will pair you.

name: New Year Doubles Shootout
format: Compass draw, so every team plays at least three matches.
description: Start the year with a full day of doubles under the January sun.
